functions.description: Computes an nginx-style rolling hash over a byte sequence. Iterates n bytes starting at src and feeds each byte to ngx_hash, returning the final key. Intended for hashing header names or similar tokens within the headers_more module.
requirements: src must point to a valid memory region of at least n bytes.
n may be zero; in that case the function returns the initial key (0) without dereferencing src.

Thread-safety follows from not using global state; the function does not modify global data.
